## What changed and why

Describe the user-visible result and the exact scientific or learning problem it addresses.

## Evidence and verification

- [ ] Tests, typecheck, lint, public-file audit and build
- [ ] Actual browser checks for changed rendering/interaction paths
- [ ] Primary sources and dates for scientific changes
- [ ] No credentials, private configuration, personal data or unrelated files
- [ ] Scientific confidence, unknown values and original snapshot provenance preserved
- [ ] Lesson targets, explanations, answer keys and written alternatives checked when applicable
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, reduced-motion and mobile paths checked when applicable

List the commands, browser/viewports and actual outcomes. Mark checks that do not apply; do not claim browser or GPU verification from a build alone.

## Limitations / untested paths

Include inherited security findings, unresolved source disagreements and any claim that still needs review. A green test is not permission to hide them.
